model.asymptotic_divergence: for degree-8 F, hazard_k is order (log k)^(-3/2), hence expected_count_to_K diverges like K/(log K)^(3/2) up to constants
model.calibration: concave first-event likelihood on fit classes only
model.independence_warning: Bernoulli first-arrival approximation; BH and clean events are not proved independent
model.prime_probability: k=0 exactly 1 (q1 is fixed prime by class construction); k>0 min(1,(N/phi(N))/log(q1+kN))

predeclared_split.rule: SHA256('L18-divergence-v1|' + class_key), first 64 bits mod 5; residue 0 held out
